title: Food Service Worker: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: Meet a food service worker in long-term care and see how meal prep, resident relationships, and reliable routines shape the workday.
takeaway: Support roles in health care are not only clinical; food service workers help turn care plans into daily comfort.

title: Nursing: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: A look at nursing in long-term care, from clinical judgement and medication support to the relationships nurses build with residents.
takeaway: Long-term care nursing rewards people who want clinical skill and sustained human connection in the same career.

title: Recreation Professional: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: Follow a recreation professional who plans activities, creates social moments, and helps residents stay connected to interests and community.
takeaway: Recreation work shows how creativity and care can belong in the same health-care career path.

title: Food Services: Careers in Long-Term Care
description: Explore the broader food services team in long-term care and how kitchen work, nutrition needs, and resident preferences come together.
takeaway: Behind every meal is a team balancing safety, dignity, culture, and care for people they see every day.

title: Physiotherapy: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: See how physiotherapy supports mobility, confidence, recovery, and independence for residents in a long-term care setting.
takeaway: Physiotherapy in long-term care is about helping people keep as much independence as possible, one practical movement at a time.

title: Housekeeping: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: A day-in-the-work look at housekeeping in long-term care, where cleanliness, safety, and resident respect are part of the same job.
takeaway: Housekeeping is frontline care too; clean, safe spaces change how residents feel and how the whole home runs.

title: Social Work: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: Meet social work in long-term care and how the role supports residents, families, transitions, advocacy, and emotional wellbeing.
takeaway: Social work is a bridge between care, family, and systems when people are making some of life's hardest transitions.

title: Music Therapy: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: See how music therapy uses creativity, memory, emotion, and clinical goals to support residents in long-term care.
takeaway: Music therapy turns artistic skill into health-care impact, especially for residents whose needs go beyond words.

title: Personal Support Workers: Making a Difference in Long-Term Care
description: A close look at personal support workers and the hands-on help, observation, and trust they bring to long-term care every day.
takeaway: Personal support workers often know residents best because their work is built from repeated moments of practical care.

title: Edge Factor Career Profiles: Food Service Worker
description: An Edge Factor profile of a food service worker, showing the pace, teamwork, and service mindset behind long-term care meals.
takeaway: Food service can be an entry point into health care for students who like hands-on work and serving people directly.

title: Edge Factor Career Profiles: Personal Support Worker
description: An Edge Factor profile of a personal support worker and the daily care, communication, and responsibility the role involves.
takeaway: PSW work is personal, physical, and relational; it is a strong fit for people who want visible impact every shift.

title: Edge Factor Career Profiles: Registered Practical Nurse - IPAC Lead
description: A career profile of a registered practical nurse working as an infection prevention and control lead in long-term care.
takeaway: Health-care roles can grow into specialties, leadership, and systems work without losing their connection to residents.

title: Edge Factor Skilled Responders: Long-Term Care Administrator
description: A profile of long-term care administration and the coordination, leadership, and decision-making needed to keep a home running.
takeaway: Care homes also need operators and leaders who can balance people, policy, staffing, safety, and service.

title: Neuro-Behavioural Nurse Practitioner: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: See how a neuro-behavioural nurse practitioner supports complex resident needs through assessment, care planning, and collaboration.
takeaway: Specialized nursing careers can combine advanced clinical thinking with deep knowledge of how behaviour and environment interact.

title: Nurse Practitioner: A Career in Long-Term Care
description: A look at the nurse practitioner role in long-term care, including advanced assessment, treatment decisions, and team-based support.
takeaway: Nurse practitioners show how a nursing path can expand into diagnosis, prescribing, leadership, and complex care.

title: Collaboration in Long-Term Care: Soft Skills on the Job
description: A soft-skills look at collaboration in long-term care and how different roles coordinate around resident needs.
takeaway: In care work, collaboration is not a bonus skill; it is how residents experience one connected team instead of separate jobs.

title: Critical Thinking in Long-Term Care: Soft Skills on the Job
description: A soft-skills look at critical thinking in long-term care and how workers notice changes, weigh options, and make good calls.
takeaway: Critical thinking matters in hands-on care because small observations can change what a resident needs next.
